# A split button's trigger click also runs the main button's handler

Owned and urgent (found while reviewing #21871, the Engine 14 cut is about a day out), so no `good first issue` label.

## Context

`examples/button/split` on `dev` `50fcfc526c`, in the browser: one click on the caret trigger opens the menu **and** logs `button click => neo-split-button-1`, the main button's handler. #21871's new toolbar example works around it: its `onPrimaryInsert` handler runs only `if (path.some(node => node.id === component.id))`, with the JSDoc "The menu trigger has its own element and can bubble through the split button's logical ancestry." Every app that copies that example copies the workaround.

Design authority: `src/button/Split.mjs:6-7`, the class contract: "A click on the main button runs its handler. The trigger button opens the menu, if one is configured, and runs splitButtonHandler."

## The Problem

The trigger is a child `Neo.button.Base` with `parentId: me.id` (`Split.mjs:76-92`). Its `click` domListener runs `splitButtonHandler` and toggles the menu; then `Neo.manager.DomEvent`'s logical bubbling (`src/manager/DomEvent.mjs:203-231`) carries the same click to the split itself, whose inherited `button.Base#onClick` (`src/button/Base.mjs:733-741`) runs the main `handler`. #21430 (closed, mine) pinned the reverse direction (a main click does not open the menu, AC-2) but never a trigger click against the main handler.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Neo.manager.DomEvent` supports both ways to stop a logical bubble: a listener with `bubble: false`, and `data.cancelBubble` (`DomEvent.mjs:218`, `:267`).
- The split's main element carries the split's own id (`getVdomRoot()` maps the main button), so a click path that holds the trigger's id is a trigger click.

## The Fix

`Neo.button.Split` keeps a trigger click on the trigger: the split's own click handling returns when the click path holds the trigger button's id, so `handler` runs only for the main button, as the class doc says. Then #21871's example (once merged) drops its path check and names `onInsertHeading` directly.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: A click on the trigger opens the menu and runs `splitButtonHandler`, and the main `handler` does not run; a click on the main button runs `handler` once and opens no menu (component spec, real clicks through the DOM event path).
- [ ] AC-2: `examples/button/split`: a caret click logs no `button click` line.
- [ ] AC-3: If #21871 has merged first, its `onPrimaryInsert` path check is gone and the split names `onInsertHeading`; otherwise the fix PR says so on #21871.

## Out of Scope

Other composite buttons; the menu's keyboard behaviour; `Neo.button.Menu`.
